name: plan-clean
title: Planning against the doctor fixture above
note: The action payloads were added in PLAN §15 issue 6, because RFC 0006 §Plan persistence makes apply --plan execute the artifact a reviewer approved, which requires the bytes to be in the plan. The marker-block action carries a `//` fence because the RFC transcript patches a marker block into settings.json; strict JSON has no comment syntax, and the action family for a JSON file is merge-json. The transcript is normative so the kind is preserved here, and the discrepancy is reported against RFC 0006 rather than corrected silently.
